scope: 7 representative list/shop/reveal boards; instructions only for parent normal UI execution

coordinateSpace.rects: absolute even when parent is set

executionRules: Use only normal UI actions; this file is not a saved model, tool schema, design import, or source edit.
Actions are ordered; every parent key refers to an earlier action.
Text remains native op:text, separate from image pixels and button skins. Numeric weights are used.
Buying, claiming and Go actions are sample navigation only; wire to prepared local sample confirmation/reward pages, never a live purchase.
Do not display screenshot frames/crops as production. All path/region images are prepared assets.
Repeated cards share identical dimensions by role. Resource/glyph substitutes and omitted repeated rows are explicitly listed in each family notes.

families.name: Page_ACE_PilotList
families.purpose: Pilot collection: nine equal cards, observed first six level labels, filter and amplification affordance.
notes: Nine freshly generated portrait cells are reference-inspired approximations, not confirmed character identities.
Source steampunk wall is approximated by a flat brown root because a matching clean backdrop is unavailable.
Original rarity badges, ability sub-icons and global icon navigation are omitted; first six level labels are retained. Third-row labels are behind the source bottom tabs and omitted.
Pilot and Pappo are two separate native text captions. Pappo destination content is unobserved; no Pappo input route is added.

families.name: Page_ACE_SpecialPack_Limited
families.purpose: Two-column Special Pack offer grid; four representative complete source offers and native purchase-entry targets.
notes: Only the first two complete rows (four offers) are included; original lower partial rows and long-scroll products repeat the same card structure and are excluded from this representative board.
Prepared glyphs replace the source bundle paintings. The red bottle and exact gear art are not available; no unrelated character portrait substitutes are used.
Product-card and price buttons are separate native targets. Their eventual destination is the sample confirmation flow, never a live payment.
Header currency values are native text; exact source currency pictograms are omitted here, and no new currency balances are inferred.

Shop footer keeps independent native text captions inside each of the four destination buttons at 14px. The back chevron is also a separate native caption because deleting the old combined string would otherwise remove it. Original nav pictograms remain omitted.

families.name: Page_ACE_CharacterReveal_Scott
families.purpose: Independent character reveal page: new stage background, native A Scott, cream bear + plane, and transparent dismiss input only.
notes: Scott is the cream bear pilot with propeller plane. Earlier penguin-like speculation was corrected using the actual full-body source frame.
Prepared acecraft_character_reveal_bear_plane_v001.webp is a new reference-inspired illustration, not a cropped original or an exact identity reproduction.
This board requires the bear-plane asset to exist and decode. If it fails, mark the board incomplete; do not silently substitute another portrait.
